findings.title: Concurrent group deletion still NPEs on subgroup streams
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() now treats a missing delegate as null, but the three filtered/paginated getSubGroupsStream overloads still do modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) with no null check (lines 256, 262, and 268). modelSupplier is the same lazy loader and returns null once the group has been deleted out from under a cached GroupAdapter. Any concurrent subgroup query on that adapter still throws NullPointerException, so the failure this change is meant to stop remains on those APIs. Null-check the delegate the same way, or otherwise fail consistently, before calling through.

findings.title: Concurrent group test neither overlaps nor observes the reader
findings.body: createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts a non-daemon reader and then deletes groups and asserts caughtExceptions is empty without waiting for the reader to start, join, or finish its in-flight call. deletedAll is set only after deletes, and the reader checks that flag only between requests, so the assertion can run before any read overlaps a delete and before an exception from the last call is added to the list. The regression can pass without ever hitting the race, a real NPE can be missed, and the leftover thread keeps using the shared admin client into later tests.
